narrative.text: I’ve read the review report and confirmed the worktree is clean at the requested base. I’ll run the baseline suite and typecheck before editing, then address the findings and prepare local commits and reply drafts without posting anything.Both baseline typechecks passed; the full suite is still running. For the default-completion finding, I’ll use the brief’s permitted policy-rationale option: document a proposal, not an approved decision, to retain Membrane defaults. I’ll add wait-ceiling boundary tests and correct the migration advice’s side effects.The first baseline run ended with two module-load errors for `solid-js`, not assertion failures. I started Bun before installing the web dependencies; both affected test files now pass in a fresh process. I’m rerunning the full baseline with dependencies ready before making source edits.The dependency-ready baseline passed: 4,290 tests, plus host and web typechecks. I’m now adding the boundary tests, correcting the migration guidance, and documenting the undecided policy proposal.Two local commits are ready. The new coverage and guidance changes passed the focused tests, and both typechecks passed at the final commit. The full head suite is running. Finding 2 is documented as an undecided proposal; retry behavior remains unchanged.Final verification passed: 4,296 tests at head versus 4,290 at base, with host and web typechecks passing at both commits. The worktree is clean. I’m finalizing the evidence report; the breaking-policy choice remains explicitly undecided in `replies.md`.
